limitations: Evidence class: software verification of the extension registry (admission, identity, discovery, operations) against independent expectations: MODEL_BASES (never read by the generator), F0's M9 set, brute-force D5, hashlib recomputations. Status is not reviewed: no reviewed status is claimed by the build lane.
Requirements empty: F1 maps to no D/A requirement; it is a 0.5 foundation package (target architecture section 3, ADR 0060).

CI has not run at this commit: the E-F1-5 step in .github/workflows/ci.yml is committed and needs the workflow scope to push. E-F1-5 is shown on Linux x86-64 here only; the manifest is re-taken at the CI-green head.

ADR 0025 D2.3's sha256 partition is red (F1.ADR0025): application-results.schema.json, a v2-scope schema, declares descriptor_sha256, registry_sha256 and self_sha256, which F1's addendum classifies for its own schemas only. Four tests fail; CI's check job will fail until the design lane rules (a reuse rule for v2-scope schemas, a restructured $defs, or a v3 policy) and the build lane applies it.

The two tool descriptions (list_capabilities, check_admission) await the design lane's and Frank's recorded reviews; tests/test_t08_w2_description_reviews.py stays red until both are recorded. The F1 review conditions the tested status and the merge on them.

N4 (F1 review): implementation.modules paths are compared exact-case; on a case-insensitive file system (macOS, Windows) a wrong-case path resolves where Linux quarantines it with self_hash_unavailable.
N5 (F1 review): a zip or frozen build has no files under the built-in import root, so the built-in self-hashes cannot be computed and the process registry fails to build.
E-F1-5 on the X07a legs (Windows, macOS) is pending until those legs exist (ADR 0060 risk 7); LF normalisation of the self-hash makes the value independent of checkout line endings.

SF-8 trusts the digest for descriptor_problem only: a change to descriptor_problem's own code is outside table_sha256, and is caught by registry_builtin.py --check, which validates in full, in CI. Tokens, limitation codes, normalisation and self-hashes run for every table.

Design-lane questions left open in docs/F1_DECISIONS.md: F-4 (the lca contributor refused dependency_missing where bw2data or bw2calc is absent), F-5 (D1's core for record_type, correlation_form, data_source extensions), W1-17 (V03.A31(a)'s text scan), SF-5 (the interfaces-frozen section 3 note, ADR 0047 C1).
